# National Backward Krushi Vidyapeet Solapur

}}
National Backward Krushi Vidyapeet Solapur  is a  college in Solapur, Maharashtra state, India.
Established in 2014, the college provides programs in agriculture education, research, and resources.\
Closed at 2026
